selection_rule: Reserve one contiguous <=72-word window for every retained source in source order, greedily maximizing novel material dimensions then claim/question/gap overlap. Reserve minimum space for remaining sources. Fill remaining total passage/word allowance by same stable ranking. No source removed. Stride56 unchanged.
actual_resource_change: Same total selected-passage count and words or fewer; same source inventory. Per-source max2 is replaced by global allocation and can be exceeded. This is an explicit allocation intervention, not a same-per-source result.
screen: Inspect exact historic monetary valuation, original identity role, conversion, independent reported replication and explicit method; retain adverse/qualifying text. No cue-only efficacy claim; existing semantic gates unchanged. No service sends.
prior_negative: V1 did not add needed dated evidence; V2 added dated valuation but traded away the only former-mayor passage. Both failures are retained.
